text: Crucix — open-source real-time geopolitical/ssecurity monitoring dashboard. Satellite fire tracking, flight/ship tracking, conflict zones, crypto/markets, Telegram social sentiment. 26 live sources, every 15 min. Alerts via Telegram/Discord, no cloud server needed. Live demo: www.crucix.live
